[center]Mod that makes monster looks like the screenshot: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40350]Radical Raiders - a Monster Redesign and Variant Mod[/url][/center]

Ever feel like the valley is [i]too[/i] peaceful?

[b]Random Monster Ambush[/b] adds surprise monster attacks while you explore, turning normal travel into tense “watch your back” moments — especially at night.

[b][color=#00ff00]Why you’d want this mod
[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Makes wandering around the world more exciting and unpredictable.
[*]Adds danger without forcing you into dungeons.
[*]Fully configurable so you can keep it light (rare ambushes) or go full chaos mode.
[*]Pick which monsters can appear and when ambushes are allowed.
[/list][line][b][color=#00ff00]Features

[/color][/b][list]
[*]Random ambush checks happen on a timer (configurable).
[*]Spawns a small group of monsters around you (configurable max).
[*]Optional [b]Elite Boss[/b] ambushes (bigger, glowing, tougher).
[*]Can be limited to nighttime only, or allowed during the day.
[*]Can block ambushes indoors by default (recommended).
[*]Monsters spawned by ambushes are cleaned up the next in-game day.
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39891/39891-1766002079-1071855525.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[list]
[/list][line][b][color=#00ff00]Configuration (GMCM Options)
[/color][/b]
Open GMCM in-game to customize everything.

[b][color=#00ffff]General settings

[/color][/b][list]
[*][b]Enable mod[/b]
Turns the entire mod on or off.[*][b]Check interval (ticks)[/b]
How often the game rolls for an ambush (60 ticks ≈ 1 second).[i]Default: 120 ticks.[/i][*][b]Ambush chance[/b]
The chance an ambush happens when a check runs (0.00–1.00).[i]Default: 0.10 (10%).[/i][*][b]Max monsters per ambush[/b]
Maximum number of monsters that can spawn in one ambush.[*][b]Minimum spawn distance[/b]
How close monsters are allowed to spawn to you (in tiles).[*][b]Maximum spawn distance[/b]
How far monsters are allowed to spawn from you (in tiles).[*][b]Allow daytime ambushes[/b]
If OFF, ambushes won’t happen before 6:00 PM.[*][b]Ambush start time[/b]
The earliest time ambushes can start (e.g. 1800 = 6:00 PM).If daytime ambushes are OFF, this will be forced to 6:00 PM or later.[*][b]Disallow indoor ambushes[/b] [i](default ON)[/i]
If ON, ambushes only happen outdoors (blocks [b]all[/b] indoor maps, including modded interiors).[*][b]Skip during events & festivals[/b]
If ON, ambushes won’t happen during festivals, events, cutscenes, or minigames.[*][b]Skip ambushes while holding a fishing rod[/b]
If ON, ambushes won’t happen if you’re currently holding any fishing rod.[/list][line][b][color=#00ffff]Monster types
[/color][/b]
These toggles let you choose exactly what can appear:

[list]
[*][b]Green Slime[/b]
[*][b]Dust Spirit[/b]
[*][b]Bat[/b]
[*][b]Rock Crab[/b]
[*][b]Ghost[/b]
[*][b]Skeleton[/b]
[*][b]Squid Kid[/b]
[*][b]Shadow Brute[/b]
[*][b]Shadow Shaman[/b]
[*][b]Serpent[/b]
[/list](If you turn one off, it will never spawn in ambushes.)
[line][b][color=#00ffff]Boss ambushes
[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable boss ambu[/b][b]shes[/b]
Allows elite boss ambushes to happen sometimes.[*][b]Boss ambush chance[/b]
Chance that a successful ambush includes a boss monster.[i]Default: 0.10 (10%).[/i][*][b]Boss health multiplier[/b]
Multiplies the boss monster’s HP (2.0 = double HP).[*][b]Boss damage multiplier[/b]
Multiplies the boss monster’s damage (2.0 = double damage).[/list][b]Elite bosses are larger and glow[/b], so you can instantly tell it’s a boss.
[line][b][color=#00ff00]Notes
[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod doesn’t edit game files (SMAPI mod only).
[*]Works best with GMCM so you can tweak settings easily.
[*]“Disallow indoors” is ON by default to avoid ambushes inside shops/homes.
[/list]

[b][size=4][center][color=#ffff00]F&Q:[/color][/center][/size][/b]
[b]Q: Do I need a new save?[/b]
A: No, you can add or remove this mod anytime.

[b]Q: Do I need Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)?[/b]
A: No, but GMCM is strongly recommended so you can change settings in-game.

[b]Q: Where do ambushes happen?[/b]
A: By default, ambushes only happen [b]outdoors[/b] because “Disallow indoor ambushes” is ON.

[b]Q: Can ambushes happen indoors (shops/houses/buildings)?[/b]
A: Yes—turn OFF [b]Disallow indoor ambushes[/b] in GMCM.

[b]Q: Why don’t ambushes happen in the Mines / Skull Cavern?[/b]
A: Those are indoor locations, so they’re blocked when [b]Disallow indoor ambushes[/b] is ON.

[b]Q: Can I allow Mines but still block other indoors?[/b]
A: Not in the current version, but it’s easy to add an “Allow Mines” exception option.

[b]Q: Can I choose which monsters can spawn?[/b]
A: Yes—there’s a “Monster types” section in GMCM where you can toggle each monster on/off.

[b]Q: How do I make ambushes rarer or more common?[/b]
A: Change [b]Ambush chance[/b] (and/or increase [b]Check interval[/b] to roll less often).

[b]Q: What does “Check interval (ticks)” mean?[/b]
A: It’s how often the mod rolls for an ambush; [b]60 ticks ≈ 1 second[/b].

[b]Q: Can I make ambushes only happen at night?[/b]
A: Yes—turn OFF [b]Allow daytime ambushes[/b] and set [b]Ambush start time[/b] to the time you want.

[b]Q: What is an Elite Boss?[/b]
A: It’s a tougher ambush monster that is [b]bigger, glowing[/b], and gets HP/damage multipliers.

[b]Q: Can I turn bosses off completely?[/b]
A: Yes—turn OFF [b]Enable boss ambushes[/b].

[b]Q: Can ambushes interrupt festivals, events, or cutscenes?[/b]
A: No—if [b]Skip during events & festivals[/b] is ON, the mod won’t spawn during those.

[b]Q: Does this mod edit game files (XNB)?[/b]
A: No, it’s a SMAPI mod only.

[b]Q: Is it safe to remove?[/b]
A: Yes—monsters spawned by the mod are cleaned up automatically, and removing the mod won’t break your save.

[b]Q: I’m fishing and keep getting ambushed—can I stop that?[/b]
A: Yes—turn ON [b]Skip ambushes while holding a fishing rod[/b].
